meta.name: security
meta.description: How to handle `GRIDA-SEC-<id>` security boundaries in the Grida repo. Triggers when you encounter a `GRIDA-SEC` tag in source/docs, when modifying files under any tagged path, or when adding a new prevented- vulnerability record. Each `GRIDA-SEC-<id>` identifies a structural trust boundary documented in `/SECURITY.md`. This skill explains the contract, mandates a security review before committing changes to any tagged file, and shows how to register a new id. Use whenever "GRIDA-SEC" appears in context.
